39:     public final void process(List<JSONObject> mapResult) {
40:         if (!mapResult.isEmpty()) {
41:             pageCache = context.getParam("pageCache");
42:             beforeBuildEntry(mapResult);
43:             CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, "30");
44:             buildEntry(mapResult);
45:             context.setParam("accountRows", accountRowMap.values());

51:     private void setInvoiceOffsetData() {
52:         String entityId = context.getView().getEntityId();
53:         if ("true".equals(ErStdConfig.get("clySetInvoiceOffset.expense")) && "8b4t_er_dailyreimbur_zh".equals(entityId)) {
54:             IDataModel model = context.getView().getModel();
55:             if (model.getProperty("costcompany") == null) {
56:                 return;
57:             }
58:             if (model.getProperty("expenseentryentity") == null) {
59:                 return;
60:             }
61:             DynamicObject company = (DynamicObject) model.getValue("costcompany");
62:             String taxtypechoose = (String) ErCommonUtils.getEMParameter(company.getLong("id"),
63:                     "taxtypechoose");
64:             DynamicObjectCollection expenseentryentity = model.getEntryEntity("expenseentryentity");
65:             if (StringUtils.isEmpty(taxtypechoose) || StringUtils.equals(taxtypechoose,"1") || StringUtils.equals(taxtypechoose,"3")) {
66:                 Set<String> config = ErStdUtil.getDefaultCustomErStdConfig("clySetInvoiceOffset.expensenumber");
67:                 if (expenseentryentity.size() > 0) {
68:                     for (int i = 0; i < expenseentryentity.size(); i++) {
69:                         DynamicObject entryItem = expenseentryentity.get(i);
70:                         BigDecimal taxamount = entryItem.getBigDecimal("taxamount");
71:                         if (entryItem != null && entryItem.containsProperty("expenseitem") && entryItem.get("expenseitem") != null) {
72:                             DynamicObject expenseitem = entryItem.getDynamicObject("expenseitem");
73:                             if (expenseitem != null && expenseitem.containsProperty("number") && expenseitem.get("number") != null) {
74:                                 String number = expenseitem.getString("number");
75:                                 if (config.contains(number)) {

79:                                     model.setValue("deductibletax", taxamount, i);

81:                                 }

83:                         }
84:                     }

102:     private void buildEntry(List<JSONObject> mapResult) {
103:         int mapSize = mapResult.size();
104:         double progress = 30;
105:         double oneRange = 40d / mapSize;
106:         for (int mapRow = 0; mapRow < mapSize; mapRow++) {
107:             JSONObject record = mapResult.get(mapRow);
108:             buildEntryRow(record, mapRow);
109:             buildAccountRowMap(record, mapRow);
110:             progress = progress + oneRange;
111:             CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, String.valueOf((int) progress));
112:         }
113:     }

120:      */
121:     protected abstract void buildEntryRow(JSONObject record, int mapRow);

128:      */
129:     private void buildAccountRowMap(JSONObject record, int mapRow) {
130:         DynamicObject supplier = (DynamicObject) record.get("supplier");
131:         DynamicObject entryCurrency = (DynamicObject) record.get("entrycurrency");
132:         BigDecimal amount = (BigDecimal) context.getView().getModel().getValue("expenseamount", mapRow);
133:         BigDecimal currAmount = (BigDecimal) context.getView().getModel().getValue("currexpenseamount", mapRow);
134:         Map<Object, Object> accountData = accountRowMap.get(supplier.get("id"));
135:         if (accountData != null) {
136:             accountData.put("receiveamount", currAmount.add((BigDecimal) accountData.get("receiveamount")));
137:             long srcCurrency = (long) accountData.get("srccurrency");
138:             if (srcCurrency != -1) {
139:                 if (srcCurrency == entryCurrency.getLong("id")) {
140:                     accountData.put("orireceiveamount", amount.add((BigDecimal) accountData.get("orireceiveamount")));
141:                 } else {
142:                     accountData.put("srccurrency", -1L);
143:                 }
144:             }
145:         } else {
146:             accountData = new HashMap<>();
147:             accountData.put("supplier", supplier);
148:             DynamicObjectCollection bankEntry = supplier.getDynamicObjectCollection("entry_bank");
149:             for (int i = 0, bankSize = bankEntry.size(); i < bankSize; i++) {
150:                 DynamicObject row = bankEntry.get(i);
151:                 if (row.getBoolean("isdefault_bank")) {
152:                     DynamicObject accountCurrency = row.getDynamicObject("currency");
153:                     if (accountCurrency != null) {
154:                         accountData.put("accountcurrency", accountCurrency);
155:                     }
156:                     break;
157:                 }
158:             }
159:             accountData.put("srccurrency", entryCurrency.getLong("id"));
160:             accountData.put("orireceiveamount", amount);
161:             accountData.put("receiveamount", currAmount);
162:             accountRowMap.put(supplier.get("id"), accountData);
163:         }

37: 
38:     private final IFormView view;
39:     private final IPageCache pageCache;
40: 
41:     public CLYMonthlyLinkProcess(IFormView view, IFormView cacheView) {
42:         this.view = view;
43:         pageCache = cacheView.getPageCache();
44:         //启用大发票，父页面缓存copy到子页面缓存
45:         String enableBigInvoice = view.getPageCache().get("enableBigInvoice");

48:             LOG.error("enableBigInvoice copy to pageCache");
49:         }
50:     }

53:     public void run() {
54:         process(true);
55:     }
56: 
57:     public void process(boolean isSerialize) {
58:         Logger logger = new Logger(this.getClass(), true).setObjectCode("cly").setIsInit(false).setBillInfo(view);
59:         AbstractCLYPubBillHelper helper = null;
60:         try {
61:             helper = CLYEnvironmentUtil.getHelper(view);
62:             CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, "3");
63:             if (helper == null) {
64:                 throw new ExtException(ResManager.loadKDString("请检查差旅云单据注册信息，当前单据不支持关联月结导入功能。",
65:                         "CLYMonthlyLinkProcess_0", "8b4t-cmhk-zh"));
66:             }
67:             helper.getContext().setParam("pageCache", pageCache);
68:             helper.callPreServices();
69:             CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, "7");
70:             if (helper.getContext().getJsdhs().length() > 0) {
71:                 JSONObject clyData = selectData(helper.getContext(), logger);
72:                 CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, "10");
73:                 String errorInfo = null;
74:                 String responseInfo = null;
75:                 JSONArray returnData = null;
76:                 if (clyData != null) {
77:                     responseInfo = clyData.toJSONString();
78:                     returnData = clyData.getJSONArray("zdDetailList");
79:                     if (returnData == null) {
80:                         errorInfo = "接口返回--zdDetailList--为空";
81:                     }
82:                 } else {
83:                     errorInfo = "接口返回为空";
84:                 }
85:                 if (errorInfo == null) {
86:                     logger.setResponseInfo("请求接口正常", responseInfo).apiSuccessLog();
87:                     List<JSONObject> mapResult = buildData(helper, returnData);
88:                     CLYEnvironmentUtil.updateClyData(helper.getContext().getJsBillMap().values().toArray(new DynamicObject[0]));

95:                         CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, "70");
96:                         if (helper.getContext().getConfig().isImportInvoice() && helper.getInvoiceService() != null) {
97:                             helper.getInvoiceService().process(helper.getContext().getParam("invIdResult"));
98:                         }
99:                         CLYEnvironmentUtil.setMonthlyProgress(pageCache, "90");
100:                         helper.getAccountService().process();
101:                     }
102:                 } else {
103:                     logger.setResponseInfo(errorInfo, responseInfo).setIsTest(true).apiFailLog();
104:                     throw new ExtException(
105:                             ResManager.loadKDString("获取所选月结单数据失败，请联系管理员处理", "CLYMonthlyLinkProcess_1",
106:                                     "8b4t-cmhk-zh"));
107:                 }

113:             error(view, helper, ResManager.loadKDString("关联差旅云结算单异常", "CLYMonthlyLinkProcess_2", "8b4t-cmhk-zh"));
114:         }

184:         JSONObject[] resultTemp = new JSONObject[mapResult.size()];

187:             if (record.getBigDecimal("expenseamount").compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) != 0) {
188:                 DynamicObject exp = (DynamicObject) record.get("expenseitem");
189:                 String value = exp == null ? "" : exp.getString("number");
190:                 int i = 0;
191:                 for (; i < index; i++) {
192:                     DynamicObject expTemp = (DynamicObject) resultTemp[i].get("expenseitem");
193:                     String valueTemp = expTemp == null ? "" : expTemp.getString("number");
194:                     if (value.compareTo(valueTemp) < 0) {
195:                         break;
196:                     }
197:                 }
198:                 for (int j = index; j > i; j--) {
199:                     resultTemp[j] = resultTemp[j - 1];
200:                 }
201:                 resultTemp[i] = record;
202:                 index++;
203:             }
204:         }
205:         List<JSONObject> result = new ArrayList<>(index);
206:         for (int i = 0; i < index; i++) {
207:             result.add(resultTemp[i]);
208:         }

content.text:
## 结论

报错来自 `CLYEnvironmentUtil.setAss` 的一个 `exists` 判断（`cmssc/code/cmhk/8b4t-cmhk-zh/src/main/java/kd/cmhk/api/cly/util/CLYEnvironmentUtil.java:452-472`）：对每条带项目信息的费用明细行，它会用下面四个条件去查「费用项目核算维度」`8b4t_costitem_asstacttype`。

| 条件 | 代码位置 |
|---|---|
| `costitem = 分录费用项目` | 453 行 |
| `entryentity.company in 单据头 company 及核算上级组织` | 403-407、438 行 |
| `entryentity.departmenttype = 单据头 costdept.departmenttype` | 437-439 行 |
| `entryentity.projecttype = 项目类型(核算维度基础资料)` | 454 行 |

只要查不到，就会把 `sqdh` 追加到 `cosNulls`，最后在 486-489 行抛出**「订单编号所关联项目在壹招报中无对应的费用项目核算维度配置，请手工补填：…」**。因此，它本身是“主数据缺失”类校验，但这段代码有三个问题，容易把“其实有配置”误判成无配置：

1. **部门类型取错了层级**：`437` 行用的是**单据头** `costdept` 的部门类型，而综合报销和日常报销的承担部门在**分录级** `entrycostdept` 上。同一仓库中 `cmssc/code/cmhk/8b4t-cmhk-zh/src/main/java/kd/cmhk/zh/opplugin/ExpenseItemLegalSubmitOp.java:81-84` 就是先判断 `8b4t_er_publicreimbu_zh`、`8b4t_er_dailyreimbur_*` 等单据，并改取 `entry.getDynamicObject("entrycostdept")`。当分录承担部门与单据头部门类型不一致时，必然查不到。
2. **空串回退永远匹配不到**：`439` 行 `deptType == null ? "" : deptType`，而配置里的部门类型是**必填**字段（`cmssc/datamodel/fi/5.0.008.0/main/8b4t_em_ext/metadata/8b4t_costitem_asstacttype.dym:1906`）。所以只要 `costdept.departmenttype` 为空，这行就一定会报错。
3. **组织取的是单据头 company**：`403` 行 `model.getValue("company")`，再用 `OrgViewType.Accounting` 取上级。而配置的「适用公司」是核算组织，分录上的 `entrycostcompany` 才是部门对应的核算组织（见 `CLYDeptBuildDataServiceImpl.java:43` 用的是 `CoreBaseBillServiceHelper.getAccountOrgId(true, deptId)`）。如果头公司不是该分录部门所在的核算组织链上，同样会查不到。

## 建议的排查与修复

**先确认是数据问题还是代码问题**（避免改错）：在「费用项目核算维度」列表里按下例过滤，能查到记录就说明是代码取数条件的问题，查不到就是真的缺配置。

- 费用项目编码 = 报错行对应的费用项目
- 项目类型 = 该行 `cmhk_projecttype`
- 部门类型 = **分录** `entrycostdept` 的部门类型（也看下单据头 `costdept` 是否为空）
- 适用公司 = 分录 `entrycostcompany` 及其核算上级

**代码侧的最小修法**：把 `setAss` 的部门和公司改成按行取，即循环内从 `model.getValue("entrycostdept", index)`、`model.getValue("entrycostcompany", index)` 拿值再拼 `QFilter`（空部门类型不要回退成 `""`，应给出明确提示）；同时把报错信息补上「费用项目编码+项目类型」，现在只有 `sqdh`，运维根本定位不到具体组合。

需要我直接按这个方案改 `CLYEnvironmentUtil.setAss` 吗？改动会附带影响 `UnlockTravelApplyPlugin` 和移动端 `MobcmhkTravelApplyPlugin` 这两处调用（出差申请单场景），我会一并核对后再动。

1: package kd.cmhk.zh.opplugin;
2: 
3: import kd.bos.dataentity.entity.DynamicObject;
4: import kd.bos.dataentity.entity.DynamicObjectCollection;
5: import kd.bos.dataentity.resource.ResManager;
6: import kd.bos.db.DB;

8: import kd.bos.entity.ExtendedDataEntity;
9: import kd.bos.entity.plugin.AbstractOperationServicePlugIn;
10: import kd.bos.entity.plugin.AddValidatorsEventArgs;
11: import kd.bos.entity.plugin.PreparePropertysEventArgs;
12: import kd.bos.entity.validate.AbstractValidator;

23: import java.util.HashSet;

25: import java.util.Set;
26: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
27: 
28: /**
29:  * 费用明细费用承担部门必须为最末级，增加参数可按共享中心类型隔离。提示语:第X行费用明细费用承担部门非末级，请重新选择。
30:  * 适用单据类型:综合共享预付单/综合共享费用报销单/综合共享对公报销单/综合共享差旅报销单/综合共享固定资产报销单/
31:  * 综合共享员工借款单/集团预付单/集团费用报销单/集团对公报销单/集团差旅单/集团固定资产报销单/集团员工借款单。
32:  * 其中差旅报销单校验单头费用承担部门，其余校验费用明细费用承担部门
33:  */
34: public class EntrycostdeptSubmitOp extends AbstractOperationServicePlugIn {
35: 
36:     private static Log logger = LogFactory.getLog(EntrycostdeptSubmitOp.class);
37: 
38:     @Override
39:     public void onPreparePropertys(PreparePropertysEventArgs e) {
40:         super.onPreparePropertys(e);
41:         List<String> fieldKeys = e.getFieldKeys();
42:         String formId = billEntityType.getName();
43:         fieldKeys.add("id");
44:         fieldKeys.add("chmk_orglongnumber");
45:         if (isTripForm(formId)) {
46:             fieldKeys.add("costdept");
47:         } else {
48:             fieldKeys.add("expenseentryentity");
49:         }
50:     }
51: 
52:     @Override
53:     public void onAddValidators(AddValidatorsEventArgs e) {
54:         super.onAddValidators(e);
55:         e.addValidator(new AbstractValidator() {
56:             @Override
57:             public void validate() {
58:                 ExtendedDataEntity[] dataEntities = this.getDataEntities();
59:                 Set<String> config = ErStdUtil.getDefaultCustomErStdConfig("submitCostDeptIsLeaf.secondNumber");
60:                 Set<String> organization = getOrganization();
61:                 for (ExtendedDataEntity entity : dataEntities) {
62:                     DynamicObject bill = entity.getDataEntity();
63:                     String orgLongNumber = (bill != null && bill.containsProperty("chmk_orglongnumber"))
64:                             ? bill.getString("chmk_orglongnumber") : null;
65:                     if (!config.contains(orgLongNumber)) {
66:                         continue;
67:                     }
68:                     String formId = billEntityType.getName();
69:                     if (isTripForm(formId)) {
70:                         DynamicObject costdept = bill.getDynamicObject("costdept");
71:                         if (costdept == null) {
72:                             continue;
73:                         }
74:                         String costdeptNumber = costdept.getString("number");
75:                         if (organization.contains(costdeptNumber)) {
76:                             //在高管独立核算中，跳过校验
77:                             continue;
78:                         }
79:                         if (!isLeafDept(costdept)) {
80:                             this.addErrorMessage(entity, ResManager.loadKDString(
81:                                     String.format("差旅报销单费用承担部门非末级，请重新选择。"),
82:                                     "EntrycostdeptSubmitOp_01", "8b4t_cmhk_zh"));
83:                         }
84:                     } else {
85:                         DynamicObjectCollection expenseEntry = bill.getDynamicObjectCollection("expenseentryentity");
86:                         if (expenseEntry == null || expenseEntry.isEmpty()) {
87:                             continue;
88:                         }
89:                         for (DynamicObject entry : expenseEntry) {
90:                             int rowIndex = entry.getInt("seq");
91:                             if (entry.containsProperty("entrycostdept") && entry.get("entrycostdept") != null) {
92:                                 DynamicObject entrycostdept = entry.getDynamicObject("entrycostdept");
93:                                 if (entrycostdept == null || !entrycostdept.containsProperty("id")) {
94:                                     continue;
95:                                 }
96:                                 String costdeptNumber = entrycostdept.getString("number");
97:                                 if (organization.contains(costdeptNumber)) {
98:                                     //在高管独立核算中，跳过校验
99:                                     continue;
100:                                 }
101:                                 if (!isLeafDept(entrycostdept)) {
102:                                     this.addErrorMessage(entity, ResManager.loadKDString(
103:                                             String.format("第 %d 行费用明细费用承担部门非末级，请重新选择。", rowIndex),
104:                                             "EntrycostdeptSubmitOp_02", "8b4t_cmhk_zh"));
105:                                 }
106:                             }
107:                         }
108:                     }
109:                 }
110:             }
111:         });
112:     }
113: 
114:     private boolean isLeafDept(DynamicObject costdept) {
115:         if (costdept == null) {
116:             return false;
117:         }
118:         QFilter qFilter = new QFilter("org", QCP.equals, ErCommonUtils.getPk(costdept));
119:         QFilter qFilter1 = new QFilter("view", QCP.equals, 1);
120:         DynamicObject orgStructures = BusinessDataServiceHelper.loadSingleFromCache("bos_org_structure", "isleaf",
121:                 new QFilter[]{ qFilter, qFilter1 });
122:         if (orgStructures != null && orgStructures.containsProperty("isleaf") && orgStructures.get("isleaf") != null) {
123:             String isleaf = orgStructures.getString("isleaf");
124:             logger.error("costdpetnumber:{},isleaf:{}", costdept.getString("number"), isleaf);
125:             if ("1".equals(isleaf) || "true".equals(isleaf)) {
126:                 return true;
127:             }
128:         }
129:         return false;
130:     }
131: 
132:     private Set<String> getOrganization() {
133:         Set<String> organization = new HashSet<>();
134:         List<Long> ret = new ArrayList<Long>();
135:         List<Long> rete = new ArrayList<Long>();
136:         //数据映射
